page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
page.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know About VedCare Divine
page.intro: Have questions about our Ayurvedic wellness products, how to use them, choosing the right product, placing an order, shipping, or customer support? We've answered some of the most common questions below to help you make informed decisions with confidence.
page.tagline: Pure Ayurveda. Better Health. A Brighter You.

faqs.question: What is VedCare Divine?
faqs.answer:
VedCare Divine is an Ayurvedic wellness brand focused on bringing traditional Ayurvedic knowledge into a modern wellness experience.

Our approach combines Ayurvedic principles, carefully selected herbs, quality-focused formulations, and practical wellness guidance to help customers make informed choices according to their individual wellness goals.

faqs.question: What does VedCare Divine believe in?
faqs.answer:
We believe wellness should be rooted in nature, guided by traditional knowledge, and presented with transparency, consistency, and care.

Our philosophy is centered around:
• Ayurvedic wisdom
• Quality ingredients
• Thoughtful formulations
• Consistent product standards
• Responsible wellness
• Customer satisfaction

faqs.question: Are VedCare Divine products Ayurvedic?
faqs.answer:
Yes. VedCare Divine products are developed based on Ayurvedic principles and incorporate Ayurvedic herbs and ingredients according to their respective formulations.

Each product has its own ingredient profile, intended use, dosage, and precautions. Customers should always refer to the individual product page and product packaging for product-specific information.

faqs.question: Where can I learn more about a product before purchasing it?
faqs.answer:
Every VedCare Divine product page is designed to provide detailed product information, including its purpose, benefits, key ingredients, usage instructions, and other relevant details.

You can review the complete product information before deciding which product is appropriate for your wellness goal.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right VedCare Divine product?
faqs.answer:
Start by identifying your primary wellness goal.

VedCare Divine products are designed around different wellness needs, including:
• Weight Gain / Mass Support
• Fat Management & Muscle Building
• Joint Care & Support
• Other specialized wellness requirements, where applicable

Once you identify your goal, review the relevant product page for its formulation, ingredients, recommended usage, and precautions.

If you are unsure which product is right for you, please consult a VedCare Divine Expert for guidance.

faqs.question: Can I use more than one VedCare Divine product at the same time?
faqs.answer:
This depends on the specific products, their ingredients, your individual requirements, and how each product is intended to be used.

We recommend reviewing the usage instructions for each product before combining products. If you are already taking medicines or other supplements, please consult a qualified healthcare professional and a VedCare Divine Expert before using multiple products together.

faqs.question: Can I choose a product based only on the expected result?
faqs.answer:
It is better to choose a product based on your overall wellness goal, formulation, ingredients, recommended usage, and individual requirements rather than focusing only on an expected outcome.

Every individual is different, and experiences with wellness products may vary from person to person.

faqs.question: How should I use VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer:
Each product has its own recommended dosage and method of use.

For products such as VedCare Gold, VedCare Build, and VedCare Build Mini, the product-specific How to Use instructions are provided on the respective product page and should be followed as directed.

Always check the product packaging before use.

faqs.question: When should I take my VedCare Divine product?
faqs.answer:
The recommended timing may differ depending on the product.

Please follow the How to Use instructions provided on the individual product page and product packaging rather than assuming that the same timing applies to every VedCare Divine product.

faqs.question: Can I take the product with water, milk, or another beverage?
faqs.answer:
This depends on the individual formulation.

Follow the preparation instructions provided for your specific product. If the product packaging provides a specific recommendation, that instruction should be followed.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss a dose?
faqs.answer:
If you miss a serving, continue with your normal recommended usage schedule.

Do not automatically take an extra serving to compensate for a missed serving unless specifically advised by a qualified healthcare professional or VedCare Divine Expert.

faqs.question: Can I take more than the recommended serving for faster results?
faqs.answer:
No.

Do not exceed the recommended serving or dosage.

Taking more than the recommended amount does not guarantee faster or better results and may not be appropriate for your individual needs.

faqs.question: What ingredients are used in VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer:
Each product has its own formulation and ingredient profile.

For example, VedCare Gold and VedCare Build contain carefully selected Ayurvedic herbs, with their respective ingredient information provided on their individual product pages.

You can use the View Full Ingredient List section on the relevant product page to review the complete ingredient information.

faqs.question: Are all VedCare Divine products made with the same ingredients?
faqs.answer:
No.

Each product is formulated for a specific wellness purpose and therefore has its own ingredient composition.

The ingredient list and formulation information should always be checked on the individual product page before purchase.

faqs.question: Why does VedCare Divine use Ayurvedic herbs?
faqs.answer:
Ayurveda has a long tradition of using herbs as part of holistic wellness practices.

VedCare Divine incorporates selected Ayurvedic ingredients into its formulations with the aim of combining traditional Ayurvedic knowledge with a convenient and modern wellness experience.

faqs.question: Can I see the complete ingredient list before purchasing?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

The complete ingredient information is provided through the View Full Ingredient List section on applicable product pages.

We encourage customers to review the ingredients carefully before purchasing, especially if they have known allergies, sensitivities, dietary restrictions, or specific health considerations.

faqs.question: How long does it take to see results?
faqs.answer:
Results can vary considerably from person to person.

Factors such as diet, lifestyle, activity level, consistency of use, sleep, individual body composition, and overall wellness can influence your experience.

Therefore, VedCare Divine does not recommend assuming that every customer will experience the same results within the same period.

faqs.question: Will I get the same results shown in transformation photos?
faqs.answer:
Individual results can vary.

Transformation photographs are shared to illustrate customer experiences and should not be interpreted as a guarantee of a particular result.

Your experience may depend on several individual factors, including your diet, lifestyle, consistency, starting point, and overall wellness routine.

faqs.question: Do VedCare Divine products work without diet and lifestyle changes?
faqs.answer:
A balanced diet, adequate nutrition, regular physical activity where appropriate, proper sleep, hydration, and a healthy lifestyle are important parts of overall wellness.

A wellness product should not be considered a replacement for a balanced lifestyle.

faqs.question: Are VedCare Divine products suitable for everyone?
faqs.answer:
VedCare Divine products are formulated as Ayurvedic wellness products and may be suitable for many individuals when used according to the recommended directions.

However, suitability can vary depending on the individual, the specific product, age, existing health conditions, medications, allergies, and other personal factors.

Always read the product label and precautions before use.

If you experience discomfort, an unexpected reaction, or any concern while using a product, discontinue use and reach out to a VedCare Divine Expert promptly. Where appropriate, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can children use VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer:
VedCare Divine products are not suitable for children unless specifically stated otherwise for a particular product.

Always follow the age-related instructions and precautions provided on the product packaging and product page.

faqs.question: Can pregnant or breastfeeding women use VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer:
Pregnancy and breastfeeding require special consideration.

Do not use a VedCare Divine product during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless its suitability has been confirmed by a qualified healthcare professional.

For products carrying a specific precaution against use during pregnancy, that precaution must be followed.

faqs.question: Can I use VedCare Divine products if I take medicines?
faqs.answer:
If you regularly take prescription or other medicines, consult your doctor or qualified healthcare professional before using a VedCare Divine product.

This is particularly important when combining multiple supplements, medicines, or herbal products.

You may also consult a VedCare Divine Expert for product-specific guidance.

faqs.question: What if I have an allergy or sensitivity to an ingredient?
faqs.answer:
Always review the complete ingredient list before using a product.

If you know that you are allergic or sensitive to any ingredient, do not use the product unless a qualified healthcare professional confirms that it is appropriate for you.

If you experience an unexpected reaction after use, discontinue use and seek appropriate medical advice. You may also contact a VedCare Divine Expert for guidance.

faqs.question: How should I store VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer:
Follow the storage instructions printed on the product packaging.

As a general precaution, keep the product properly closed and store it in a clean, dry place away from excessive heat, moisture, and direct sunlight.

faqs.question: Should I keep the container tightly closed?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

Keep the container properly closed after every use to help maintain product quality.

faqs.question: Can I use the product after its expiry date?
faqs.answer:
No.

Do not use a product after its stated expiry date.

Always check the expiry or best-before information printed on the packaging before use.

faqs.question: How can I place an order?
faqs.answer:
Select the product you want, review its product information, choose the appropriate quantity, add it to your cart, and proceed through checkout.

Please carefully review your delivery information before confirming your order.

faqs.question: Can I order VedCare Divine products online?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

VedCare Divine products can be purchased through the online shopping facility available on our website.

faqs.question: What payment methods are available?
faqs.answer:
Available payment methods are displayed during checkout.

Payment options may vary depending on the payment service and current website configuration.

faqs.question: Will I receive an order confirmation?
faqs.answer:
After successfully placing an order, you should receive an order confirmation through the contact information provided during checkout.

Please retain your order details for future reference.

faqs.question: What should I do if I entered the wrong delivery information?
faqs.answer:
Contact VedCare Divine customer support as soon as possible with your order details.

If the order has not yet been processed or dispatched, we will try to assist with correcting the delivery information where possible.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer:
Normally, VedCare Divine orders are delivered within 4–7 days, depending on the delivery location, courier service, order processing, and other logistical factors.

Delivery timelines may vary for certain locations or circumstances.

Same-day delivery may also be available at selected locations. For same-day delivery availability, please consult a VedCare Divine Expert before placing your order.

faqs.question: Do you deliver across India?
faqs.answer:
Yes. VedCare Divine delivers across India, subject to serviceability at the delivery location.

Enter your delivery address during checkout to determine whether delivery is available for your location.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order has been dispatched and tracking information becomes available, you can use the tracking details provided in your shipping update.

faqs.question: What if my order is delayed?
faqs.answer:
If your order has exceeded the expected delivery timeframe, contact VedCare Divine customer support with your order number.

Our team can help you check the current status of your shipment.

faqs.question: What should I do if I receive a damaged package?
faqs.answer:
If your package arrives damaged, document the condition of the package and product as soon as possible and contact VedCare Divine customer support.

Please retain the packaging and order details until the matter has been resolved.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer:
Order cancellation depends on the current processing and dispatch status of the order.

Contact VedCare Divine customer support as soon as possible if you need to request cancellation.

faqs.question: Can I return a product after delivery?
faqs.answer:
Returns and refunds are subject to VedCare Divine's applicable Refund Policy.

Please review the Refund Policy before placing an order.

faqs.question: What if I receive the wrong product?
faqs.answer:
If you receive a product different from the one you ordered, contact customer support with your order details and relevant photographs.

Our support team will guide you through the next steps.

faqs.question: How do I request a refund?
faqs.answer:
Refund requests are handled according to the applicable VedCare Divine Refund Policy.

Contact customer support with your order number and the reason for your request.

faqs.question: How can I contact VedCare Divine?
faqs.answer:
You can contact VedCare Divine through the customer support details provided on the website.

For order-related questions, keep your order number ready so our team can assist you more efficiently.

faqs.question: Can I ask for help choosing a product?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

If you are unsure which product best matches your wellness goal, you can contact a VedCare Divine Expert for guidance.

We encourage customers to share their wellness objective and review the relevant product information before making a purchase.

faqs.question: Where can I find product-specific information?
faqs.answer:
Product-specific information is available on each individual product page, including:
• Product purpose
• Benefits
• Key ingredients
• Full ingredient list
• How to Use
• Product information
• Relevant videos
• Transformation and customer experience content
• Applicable precautions

faqs.question: Is VedCare Divine a substitute for medical treatment?
faqs.answer:
No.

VedCare Divine products are intended for wellness purposes and should not be considered a replacement for diagnosis, treatment, or advice from a qualified medical professional.

If you have a medical condition or ongoing health concern, consult an appropriate healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can I use VedCare Divine products as part of my daily wellness routine?
faqs.answer:
Product suitability depends on the specific formulation and your individual requirements.

Follow the recommended usage instructions for the product you choose and maintain a balanced diet and healthy lifestyle.

faqs.question: Where can I find the latest information about VedCare Divine products?
faqs.answer: The individual product page and product packaging should be considered the primary sources for current product-specific information, including ingredients, usage instructions, precautions, and other applicable details.

cta.title: Still Have Questions?
cta.text:
We're here to help.

Whether you're unsure which product suits your wellness goal, need help understanding how to use a product, or have a question about your order, our team is ready to assist.
cta.heading: Talk to VedCare Divine
cta.subtext: Get the information you need before you make your wellness choice.
